requirements.title: Description of each outsourced function
requirements.missing: The RoI lists ICT services, not outsourcings in the FINMA sense: flag which arrangements are outsourcings and add non-ICT outsourcings (e.g. cash handling, back office).

requirements.title: Service provider (Rz 14)
requirements.missing: The inventory covers all significant outsourced functions, including non-ICT ones; the RoI only holds ICT providers.

requirements.title: Sub-providers of significant functions (Rz 14)
requirements.missing: Covered for ICT services; sub-providers of non-ICT outsourcings are not in the RoI.

requirements.title: Service recipient within the group (Rz 14)
requirements.missing: Swiss group entities are outside the DORA scope: add them to B_01.02 for the group view and mark them as outside the DORA reporting scope (this page, or `roi export --exclude-entity`) so the xBRL-CSV package leaves them out.

requirements.title: Responsible person or unit in the bank
requirements.missing: Not part of the RoI. Maintain a business owner / responsible unit per arrangement.

requirements.title: Assessment whether the outsourced function is significant
requirements.missing: DORA 'critical or important function' and FINMA 'significant function' are similar but not identical: record the FINMA significance assessment separately where it differs.

requirements.title: Term and notice periods – evidence for an orderly change of provider (Rz 18–18.1)
requirements.missing: Not an inventory or minimum contract requirement (Rz 14, 32–35); the dates support the orderly change of provider or insourcing (Rz 18–18.1).

requirements.title: Due diligence before selection and ongoing monitoring of the provider
requirements.missing: Only the last audit date is in the RoI. Keep due-diligence and monitoring evidence (date, result, owner).

requirements.title: Contractual security requirements and contingency framework (Rz 24–25)
requirements.missing: Data sensitivity and the Art. 30(2)(c) clause cover security in general. Critical data held abroad and its confidentiality are 2023/1 topics (Rz 79, 82); bank-client confidentiality follows from the Banking Act, not from 2018/3.

requirements.title: Business continuity of outsourced significant functions
requirements.missing: RTO/RPO and the contract clause on tested contingency plans are covered; keep the provider's BCP test results.

requirements.title: Audit and information rights for the bank, its audit firm and FINMA
requirements.missing: The Art. 30(3)(e) clauses grant rights to the 'competent authority' (an EU authority): check that FINMA and the bank's audit firm are named explicitly.

requirements.title: Abroad: enforceable audit rights, restructuring/resolution, access to data from Switzerland
requirements.missing: Governing law and locations are in the RoI; document that information needed for restructuring or resolution remains accessible from Switzerland.

requirements.title: Agreement in writing or text form; sub-outsourcing; termination (Rz 32–35)
requirements.missing: Largely covered by the Art. 30 checklist. Sub-outsourcing: the company must be informed early about the use or replacement of subcontractors and be able to terminate (Rz 33 – no prior consent since the 2020 amendment); internal approval procedures and signing powers (Rz 35) are outside the RoI.

requirements.title: Intra-group outsourcings identified (Rz 14)
requirements.missing: Covered for ICT services between DORA entities; intra-group outsourcings of Swiss entities and non-ICT outsourcings must be added.

requirements.title: Inventory of critical functions (Rz 14–16, 107)
requirements.missing: FINMA critical functions (disruption would jeopardise the institution's continuation or its role on the financial market) are a much narrower set than DORA critical or important functions – typically a few, top-down (Guidance 05/2025 §3.1): map them explicitly, with their dependencies (Rz 107).

requirements.title: Tolerance for disruption per critical function (Rz 17)
requirements.missing: A tolerance for disruption is the extent (e.g. duration or expected damage) of a disruption the institution is willing to accept, set by the executive board irrespective of its ability to recover; RTO/RPO are not evidence of it (Guidance 05/2025 §3.2). Define tolerances per FINMA critical function.

requirements.title: Mapping of critical functions to resources, incl. third parties
requirements.missing: Third-party dependencies are mapped; add people, premises, internal IT and data.

requirements.title: ICT inventory with dependencies on third parties
requirements.missing: Covers ICT services bought from third parties, not the bank's own ICT assets.

requirements.title: Critical data: location and protection, also at third parties
requirements.missing: Storage location and sensitivity are reported per service; identify which data is critical in the FINMA sense.

requirements.title: Business impact analysis, recovery objectives and tested plans
requirements.missing: Keep the BIA and test evidence; the RoI only holds the resulting RTO/RPO and impact.

requirements.title: Incident management and reporting of cyber attacks to FINMA
requirements.missing: The incident log covers the DORA classification and deadlines, which are no evidence of FINMA materiality. FINMA: significant ICT incidents and incidents involving critical data without delay (Rz 60, 81); cyber attacks with a preliminary notification within 24 hours and a report within 72 hours, then a root cause analysis (Rz 68; Guidance 05/2020, 03/2024; FINMASA Art. 29(2)) – track them separately.

requirements.title: Substitutability and exit for critical third-party dependencies
requirements.missing: Substitutability and exit plans are reported (2018/3 Rz 18–18.1; 2023/1 Rz 88, 110); test them in severe but plausible scenarios.

requirements.title: Scenario testing of operational resilience
requirements.missing: Not part of the RoI. Plan and document severe but plausible scenario tests per critical function.

requirements.title: Contractual security requirements for ICT providers
requirements.missing: Evidenced by the Art. 30 clauses on data security, security measures and training (2018/3 Rz 24; 2023/1 Rz 82, 85 – RTO/RPO agreed with providers).
